name: Lava
tagline: News-flow heat monitoring for A-shares and thematic sectors, via MCP/API
description: Lava tracks news-flow attention for China A-share stocks and thematic sectors (e.g. AI, semiconductors, new energy) and exposes it as heat scores, time windows and institution/KOL cohort views. Quant traders and AI agents can pull the data through an MCP server or REST API, compare heat across stocks, and map stocks to concepts. A must-have input for quant trading and institutional/KOL attention monitoring.
